<!-- pr-reviewer: b8e217cb8c1175212986ec87868364d87ff59587 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The metadata and generated links meet #2855. The seed case appears below Face, 2D Pocket and Drill. The checks reject missing metadata, unknown kinds, stale lists and links to unknown cases. The generator checks all pages before it writes updates.

Reviewed against upstream main's current AGENTS.md. The body has `Process change: yes`. This PR does not change PROCESS_VERSION, dependencies, machining output, geometry or safety checks. It changes no UI code or goldens.

Local results after a clean trial merge with upstream/main at `36348cda60cdd8ff66810bbb87b12f4f0f80e6b9`:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | Both steps passed |
| App `example_catalog` | 33 passed; 2 ignored |
| Xtask tests | 252 unit tests and 29 integration tests passed |
| `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |
| `git diff --check upstream/main` | Passed |

Extra suites run:

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| App `example_catalog_adaptive` | 1 passed |
| App `example_catalog_edge_work` | 1 passed |
| App `catalog_groove_part_off` | 1 passed |
| UI `catalog_render`, from `crates/ui` | 2 passed; screenshot renderer ignored |

The heavy planner selected `app heavy: example_catalog`. I ran `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --only 'app heavy: example_catalog'`. Both release tests passed: `catalog_2d_slots::rebuilds` and `catalog_2d_slots::regenerates`. These results cover the two app tests omitted from the debug run.

Requested before merge: none.

Mutations: not run. This PR does not change safety behavior. No goldens moved. The full valid-input catalog CLI command, screenshots, PDFs and machine cuts were not exercised.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
Merge: the coordinator merges head b8e217cb8 on mkinney's pr-reviewer marker on this head (Ready) and the merge-ready label. The coordinator added the label P4 of #2855.
